rootCause:
Likely cause: AWS Glue Python jobs are experiencing persistent application-level errors in the `/aws-glue/python-jobs/error` log group.

Confidence: high

Supporting evidence: Finding fb505ab1-d6fa-4815-8314-d5b9fc5fcea5 (application, high severity, count: 13) and finding 416f10c5-8b33-4e5b-a0cc-03509b2246fa (application, high severity, count: 10) both occurred in `/aws-glue/python-jobs/error` with overlapping time windows from 2026-09-01T15:46:05Z to 2026-09-02T09:59:39Z. These two high-severity application errors account for 23 of the 30 errors logged in the Python jobs error log group. Additional correlated findings (f54f6ae0-c6a6-422a-8a65-1adc4a127639, 8b81520f-5adc-4307-9942-14fa22c53b05, and 2fda762d-be5e-4273-8daa-9048e5af6e19) in the same log group show application category errors occurring in overlapping windows, indicating a sustained issue. The category count shows 9 total application-category findings across all logs, with 7 of these concentrated in the Python jobs error log group.
executiveSummary:
**Summary:**

No critical issues detected, but 20 findings across 6 affected groups warrant attention. The biggest issue is application errors (9 findings, 13 occurrences) in the `/aws-glue/python-jobs/error` log group with high severity, followed by access denied errors (4 findings).

**Is it recurring?** Yes—findings cluster at 12:00, 14:00, 10:00, and 07:00, suggesting scheduled or periodic job execution patterns.

**Investigate first:** The Glue Python job application errors in `/aws-glue/python-jobs/error` to determine root cause of the recurring high-severity failures.
